events.title: Night Happenings — Michelle Darwin
events.description: Solo show of ~25 acrylic paintings by Michelle Darwin. Nocturnal scenes around Nova Scotia, mostly in and around Lunenburg. Open 11–4 daily. To visit outside these hours, email hello@michelledarwin.com.

events.title: Tunes on Tuesday: Trio Timia
events.description: Montréal-based group Trio Timia present The Value of Chamber Music , an engaging lecture-recital exploring the artistry of collaboration. Featuring pianist Itamar Prag , violinist June Lee , and cellist François Lamontagne , this prize-winning trio will offer insight into their approach to chamber music and the works they perform.

events.title: Trio Timia
events.description: Trio Timia , formed in Montréal, brings together pianist Itamar Prag , violinist June Lee , and cellist François Lamontagne . Second Prize winners at the 2026 Fischoff Chamber Music Competition and First Prize winners at the 2026 Yellow Springs Chamber Music Competition, the trio also represented Canada at the 2026 Osaka International Chamber Music Competition, where they were one of eight piano trios selected worldwide and the only North American ensemble. events.title: Tunes on Tuesday: Sunmi Han
events.description: Pianist Sunmi Han presents The Relationship Between Music and Poetry , inviting us to consider the connection between these two art forms and the ways they speak to one another. Sunmi will share her thoughts on how music and poetry can inspire, complement, and enrich each other.

events.title: Sunmi Han, piano
events.description: While solo repertoire remains an important part of her artistic identity, chamber music and collaboration are central to Han’s work. She believes chamber music is where friendships form, stories intertwine, and listening becomes an act of generosity. Through her work as both a performer and educator, she is passionate about creating musical communities where artists grow not only in skill, but also in humanity.
